lines.2: Nagomi and I are wandering around Yokohama on a date.
lines.3: Anywhere is fun when I'm with her.
lines.4: Just having her beside me makes me happy.
lines.8: 「Nagomi, I found a dream of my own.」
lines.10: 「I'd already been planning to study economics or something when I go to college.」
lines.11: 「You want to open a restaurant someday, don't you?」
lines.12: 「...When you get right down to it, yes.」
lines.13: 「And then people will call it delicious, and a magazine reporter will come interview me.」
lines.14: 「If I can tell them it's a dish my father taught me, I'll know I've made it.」
lines.18: 「is to help run that restaurant from the business side, so you can concentrate on cooking.」
lines.19: 「I'll study economics and management... and hopefully use it to help you.」
lines.20: 「Senpai... That makes me really happy, but... aren't you letting my dream pull yours along?」
lines.21: 「I already meant to study economics, and now I've got a good reason for it.」
lines.22: 「I used to have only vague ideas about what was right, or what kind of purpose I should have. But now I get it.」
lines.23: 「Once you've chosen someone you want to do it for, I think it's enough to give everything you have to what you can do for them.」
lines.24: 「Of course, working hard for your own sake is fine too. But that feels a little lonely.」
lines.25: 「Our dreams point in the same direction. So let's work toward them together.」
lines.27: 「Then we'll make the restaurant a huge success. It'll thrive and keep us busy.」
lines.28: 「We'll have money and fame, but we'll complain that the happiest days were when we could just relax together like this.」
lines.29: 「That really is... quite a grand dream.」
lines.30: 「If you're going to dream, you might as well dream big.」
lines.31: A dream takes shape as we talk.
lines.32: I'll have to work hard to make it come true.
lines.35: 「I think the hard part for most people is finding someone who makes them say, 'I want to do my best for this person.'」
lines.36: 「I was lucky enough to find mine.」
lines.38: 「But I don't think what happened between us was luck... It happened because you never gave up on me, no matter what I said to you.」
